diagnosis.explanation: The technical/momentum model earns its IC in volatile, trending, risk-off markets (pooled risk-off IC 0.154057) and is weakest in calm risk-on conditions (pooled risk-on IC 0.062251). 2021 was an almost pure calm risk-on / low-volatility year (risk-off day share 0.0, low-vol day share 0.9881), and within that regime the short-horizon technical signal inverted, driving the worst-year IC to -0.108464 versus 0.121708 in the other years. The failure is therefore a regime/style effect (a momentum/low-vol unwind), not random noise.

bad_year_diagnosis.risk_on_only_note: worst-year IC if the model only traded on risk-on days; shown as a diagnostic only - dropping half the calendar is not counted as robustness for the PASS gate

summary.preferred_reason: 126d has the highest OOS IC and decile spread of the three horizons, but also the worst single-year IC; it is preferred on signal strength while remaining the most fragile, which is why bad-year mitigation (not a horizon switch) is the priority.

summary.focus_model_concentration_note: focus model top feature 'momentum_21_126' carries 25.4% of mean |weight|
summary.interpretation: ridge_technical_only is a single-family (technical_price) model; its weight mass is spread across momentum / volatility / trend features with stable signs, which is why it out-performs the combined models. The combined models dilute that signal with noisy partial-earnings features (25-ticker coverage) and lack the macro / sentiment families that would carry regime information, so they underperform despite more inputs.

improvement_priorities.blocker: no local macro/inflation panel; needs a free, non-paid local source
improvement_priorities.rationale: bad-year (2021) failure is regime-driven; macro/inflation features directly encode the rate/rotation regime the model misses
cheap bad-year mitigation already testable in-memory; blends/regime routing can damp the worst-year drawdown

improvement_priorities.blocker: earnings coverage only ~25 tickers; partial-earnings features are noisy
improvement_priorities.rationale: thin earnings coverage dilutes the combined models; completing it lets the fundamental family contribute instead of adding noise

improvement_priorities.blocker: no local sentiment panel; must stay non-paid / non-faked
improvement_priorities.rationale: sentiment can add orthogonal short-horizon signal but is lower priority than the regime/macro gap behind the bad year
protect the net spread under realistic costs by damping turnover at the rebalance
63d is more stable but lower IC; a blended-horizon target may trade a little signal for robustness

improvement_priorities.blocker: current sector map is as-of, not point-in-time
improvement_priorities.rationale: removes a survivorship/look-ahead caveat but is not the driver of the bad-year fragility

recommendation.reason: Robustness WEAK but FIXABLE: the model is positive gross and survives cost at 10 bps, the 2021 bad year is explainable as a regime/style effect, and a clear improvement path exists (macro/inflation + regime gating + finishing earnings coverage). No blend tested fully clears the worst-year floor, so it is not yet pass-ready. Research-only; no production artifact, predictions, scores, weights, or edge claim.

recommended_next_phase.title: Add Macro/Inflation Data and Re-run Walk-Forward
recommended_next_phase.purpose: Add the blocked macro / inflation family (and continue earnings coverage), then re-run the walk-forward model and re-test robustness. No production candidate.

interpretation.narrative: Phase 3-Q diagnoses the Phase 3-P best model (ridge_technical_only @ 126d) without training any production model. It rebuilds research-only out-of-sample rank scores in memory (reusing the Phase 3-P / Phase 3-O helpers) and attributes the 2021 failure to adverse market regimes rather than noise, measures regime and sector performance, estimates monthly turnover and transaction-cost sensitivity, checks per-fold feature weight stability, and tests research-only ensemble blends. It computes no production predictions / scores / portfolio weights / order instructions, writes no deployable model artifact, writes nothing to the D: drive, runs no migration, restarts no prediction service, enables no model-v2 serving flag, executes no trade, and calls no provider / paid-vendor / Alpha Vantage API. The universe is current-as-of, so all results remain survivorship-biased and claim no production edge.
